citation: The efficacy and safety of hydroxychloroquine for COVID-19 prophylaxis: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials (2021); PLoS ONE; DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0244778; PMID 33406138
scope_note: RCTs; adults SARS CoV-2 negative by PCR or asymptomatic at enrolment, exposed or at high exposure risk; oral hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine prophylaxis versus no quinines or placebo. Pseudo/quasi-randomized and non-randomized studies excluded. At least one of the listed infection, symptom, hospitalization, mortality, ICU, compliance or adverse-event outcomes required.
